customPrompt:
⚠ CRITICAL RULE — READ FIRST BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE:
This is a TWO-PERSON GROUP PHOTO task. The final image MUST contain EXACTLY TWO distinct people with TWO COMPLETELY DIFFERENT FACES.
DO NOT face-swap. DO NOT replace the footballer's face. DO NOT apply Image 2's face onto the person in Image 1.
The footballer in Image 1 is PERSON A — he stays 100% unchanged, pixel-perfect, face and all.
The person in Image 2 is PERSON B — a brand-new second individual ADDED to the scene standing next to PERSON A.
If the output shows only one person, or shows PERSON A's body with PERSON B's face, the task has FAILED.

Image 1: Base scene — a professional football stadium pitch photograph taken at near eye-level to slightly low, telephoto compression, square 1:1 crop. Evening or night match atmosphere under strong artificial stadium floodlights. PERSON A: a male footballer in a red-and-yellow split Galatasaray-style short-sleeve match jersey (deep red/maroon on one side, golden yellow/orange on the other, Puma logo on chest, Galatasaray G/S crest with stars on chest, Turkish flag badge on upper chest, "PASİFİK HOLDING" sponsor text across torso), red match shorts with yellow side detail and large white number 45, standing/walking forward on the pitch in a post-goal celebration moment. Right hand raised to lips with index finger held vertically — shushing gesture aimed toward the crowd. Left hand placed across lower torso/abdomen area. Focused, intense expression with mouth open, gaze directed upward and slightly toward viewer's left/center, not at the camera. Short bleached/light-blond hair, dark skin tone, tall athletic build. Midground: blurred teammates/staff in maroon padded coats behind the player. Right edge: professional broadcast camera rig with small monitor, red cable, and partially visible dark-clothed camera operator. Background: large blurred stadium stands, dark gray/black crowd and seating, heavy background blur, dramatic contrast against the bright player and green pitch. Green football pitch surface visible across the lower portion of the frame.

Image 2: Identity reference for PERSON B only — extract the face, body proportions, and physical appearance of this person. They will be added as a SECOND person standing next to PERSON A.

Instruction:
Place PERSON B standing directly beside PERSON A, on his left side (viewer's right, away from the broadcast camera rig), on the same green pitch — as if both are participating in the same post-goal celebration moment together.

PERSON A — ZERO MODIFICATIONS:
- His face, short bleached hair, dark skin tone, intense expression, open mouth, upward gaze: unchanged
- Shushing gesture (right hand to lips, index finger vertical), left hand position across lower torso: unchanged
- Red/yellow split jersey, number 45, PASİFİK HOLDING sponsor, all branding details: unchanged
- Broadcast camera rig and partially visible operator at right edge: unchanged
- Blurred maroon-coated teammates in midground: unchanged
- Dark blurred stadium crowd and seating background: unchanged
- Green pitch foreground surface: unchanged
- Do not alter a single pixel of his appearance or the scene

PERSON B — FACE (the single most critical requirement — zero tolerance for deviation):
⚠ Image 2 contains a PHOTOGRAPH of a real person's face. You must COPY this photograph directly — do NOT generate a new face, do NOT render a generic or averaged face, do NOT use Image 2 merely as a loose reference. Treat it as a face transplant: the exact face from the photograph must appear on PERSON B's body with no alterations whatsoever.
- Face shape, skull structure, forehead height, jawline, chin: exact copy from Image 2 — not similar, IDENTICAL
- Eyes: exact shape, color, spacing, eyelid fold, brow thickness and arch — copied from Image 2 pixel-accurately
- Nose: exact shape, width, bridge height, nostril shape — copied from Image 2
- Mouth and lips: exact shape, thickness, and proportions — copied from Image 2
- Skin tone and texture: exact match including any blemishes, marks, or asymmetries — do not smooth, lighten, darken, or idealize even slightly
- Hair: exact style, color, density, part, and hairline — copied from Image 2
- Beard/stubble: exact coverage, density, color, and growth pattern — copied from Image 2 if present
- Facial asymmetry: preserve any natural asymmetry — do not correct or balance the face
- Age markers: preserve all visible age lines, wrinkles, or features — do not rejuvenate
- DO NOT generate a new face. DO NOT average the face. DO NOT idealize. DO NOT beautify.
- If Image 2's face is not reproduced with full photographic accuracy, the task has FAILED.
- A viewer who knows the person in Image 2 must be able to identify them instantly in the output

PERSON B — KIT (exact copy of PERSON A's match jersey, no improvisation):
- Top: identical red-and-yellow split short-sleeve match jersey — deep red/maroon panel on one side, golden yellow/orange panel on the other — same color split, same proportions as PERSON A's jersey
- Puma logo: same gold/white Puma logo on same chest position as PERSON A
- Galatasaray G/S crest: copy EXACTLY from PERSON A's jersey — with EXACTLY 5 STARS above it. Not 3 stars. Not 4 stars. Exactly 5 stars — the same count as visible on PERSON A's jersey in Image 1. The crest shape must be accurate and legible — do not distort, blur, or invent the badge. The 5 stars must be clearly visible, evenly spaced, and correctly rendered.
- Turkish flag badge: same red circular badge with white crescent and star on the same upper-chest position as PERSON A
- "PASİFİK HOLDING" sponsor text: same bold white capital letters, same font weight, same center-torso position as PERSON A
- Shorts: red match shorts with yellow side detail — same as PERSON A (no specific number required)
- The jersey must look physically worn — natural fabric folds, red/yellow split panel visible, stadium floodlight specular highlights on the synthetic jersey fabric, not a flat overlay
- Every logo, badge, and sponsor text must be legible and correctly rendered — no blurred, distorted, or invented graphics

PERSON B — Pose and gaze:
- PERSON B must NOT look directly into the camera
- Body and gaze naturally motivated by the scene: high-energy post-goal celebration on the pitch at night, broadcast cameras rolling, crowd reacting
- Standing beside PERSON A in a natural celebration stance — arms slightly raised or open, torso slightly turned inward toward PERSON A, sharing the celebration energy
- Gaze directed toward the crowd/stand, toward PERSON A, or upward/outward — matching the emotionally charged outward-facing energy of PERSON A's shushing gesture
- Expression: intense, triumphant, emotionally charged — matching the defiant, high-energy mood of the celebration moment
- Arms: raised, open, or gesturing naturally outward — avoid stiff or neutral standing posture; this is a celebration, not a warm-up
- Body language reads as "this person is celebrating alongside their teammate" not "this person was inserted into this photo"

Composition and scene:
- Both people stand on the same green pitch at the same depth and scale
- Camera angle: near eye-level to slightly low pitch-side, telephoto compression, square 1:1 framing
- Background: same dark gray/black blurred stadium crowd and seating, blurred maroon-coated teammates in midground, broadcast camera rig remaining visible at right edge
- Scale: both appear roughly the same height and distance from camera, standing on the same ground plane
- Depth of field: shallow — both subjects sharp, all background elements remain blurred at the same level as Image 1
- Color grading: high-contrast sports editorial — vivid red/yellow kit, saturated green pitch, subdued dark background tones

Lighting for PERSON B:
- Strong artificial stadium floodlighting, primarily frontal and overhead
- Bright crisp highlights on face/chest/arms, moderate shadows under chin and jersey folds
- Cool-neutral stadium light with warm red/yellow kit accents, high-contrast sports lighting
- Cast shadows and highlights consistent with the same lighting source as PERSON A

Final quality constraints:
- The result must look like both people were photographed together in the same single frame during the same celebration — not composited
- No watermarks. No FOTOTARENA text. No floating artifacts. No seam lines between the two people
- Both subjects must appear to be standing on the same physical green pitch ground plane
- The broadcast camera rig on the right edge must remain intact and unaltered — it is a key authenticity element of the scene
- No distorted faces, hands, logos, or badge graphics
- Photorealistic sports editorial quality, night stadium atmosphere
